title: Flight of Amenophis / Taharqa from Egypt
summary: Taharqa (identified by CFAH with Manetho's Amenophis) flees Egypt before the Assyrians; CFAH dates the start of Psammetichus's career from it.
description: Taharqa (identified by CFAH with Manetho's Amenophis) flees Egypt before the Assyrians; CFAH dates the start of Psammetichus's career from it. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 671 BC (AP-62, OSF preprint CFAH-8)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, p. 9 ("new Anchor Point #62 The Flight of Amenophis / Taharqa in 671 BC")
